answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by making each identity stake collateral, slashed when peers prove misbehavior, so spawning echo identities multiplies the capital at risk instead of multiplying influence. A non-transferable work history acts like pigment that cannot be faked quickly: new agents start near zero trust and earn weight only by serving others. Crystal-clear attestation chains let anyone audit who vouched for whom, so fresh identities vouching only for each other are visible and discounted. An attacker pays funds and time per fake identity; honest agents pay once.
